name: matrix-synapse
summary: Federated messaging homeserver for real-time chat, rooms, automation hooks, and decentralized communication workflows.
why_it_matters: Matrix Synapse preserves useful federated communication capability knowledge, but there is no current validated project-level need to actively maintain it as a supported resource.
when_to_use: A future scenario needs self-hosted real-time messaging or rooms.
The workflow depends on Matrix APIs or bot integrations.

platform_support.notes: The service is containerizable, but federation, persistence, and auth create operational complexity beyond basic startup.

prerequisites: Persistent database and media storage strategy
implementation_notes: Promotion should define whether support covers local-only use or federation as well.
Keep bot/application integration separate from homeserver operations.
Avoid claiming broad messaging-platform support without a real consumer workflow.
operational_notes: Persistence, media retention, and upgrades are the main operator concerns.
Validation should cover API readiness and a real message flow.
risks: Messaging platforms are operationally heavy without active consumers.
A wrapper could imply stronger auth and federation support than exists.
